summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for an at-the-market offering of up to $2.17M in ADSs issuable upon conversion of a convertible promissory note and 325,000 pre-delivery ADSs. The note is issued to Streeterville Capital under a Securities Purchase Agreement dated June 29, 2026. The ADSs represent ordinary shares, with each ADS representing 60 ordinary shares (changed from 3 ordinary shares). The filing is a routine equity-linked capital raise, not a special situation. The proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No premium, tender, acquisition, or other special-situation elements are present. The offering is a standard convertible note drawdown under an existing shelf registration, with no board recommendation or advisor. Mechanism: conversion shares are registered for resale. Risk-arb: none; this is a standard financing, not an event-driven situation.
